declaration-no-important.message: The kit never writes !important -- the whole layering policy (structure unlayered/normal specificity, skin at :where() zero specificity) rests on the kit staying out of specificity wars. Fix the selector, not this rule.

custom-property-pattern.message: This package may only define --mhmui-* custom properties; --mhm-* belongs to the products.

selector-class-pattern.message: This package may only style .mhmui-* classes; .mhm-* belongs to the products -- the same boundary custom-property-pattern draws for tokens, which this package drew for tokens and forgot to draw for class names (measured 2026-09-21: 51 selectors slipped through three release rounds). `dashicons` is the one exception and it is core's, not ours: the kit targets it inside its own cards. The legacy .mhm-* block in admin.css is fenced with stylelint-disable and carries its exit condition there; do not extend the fence, and do not add a new .mhm-* rule outside it.
